transformations.description: Copies complete accepted Alicante StopNode and StopPlace objects exactly when numeric operator stop codes already exist.
Uses each published numeric operator code as the stable suffix and creates one singleton StopPlace for every new code.
Projects the six visible 27A, 27B and 27C directional diagrams as six independent open patterns under route 27. No branch is concatenated and no reverse sequence is inferred.
Appends exactly one catalog descriptor and recomputes all hashes from serialized bytes.

warnings: The supplied legacy map defines route-family scope, while ordered stops and coordinates are current 2026 captures. This package does not claim a frozen historical timetable snapshot.
The supplied line 27 diagram materially changes topology modelling: 27A, 27B and 27C are separate patterns, not one ida/vuelta pair and not one concatenated itinerary.
Variant-only line 27 stops retained from the diagrams may no longer be associated with the current public line page, but their operator-code stop records and coordinates remain available.
Different numeric codes remain separate StopNodes and singleton StopPlaces even when names match or stops lie close together.
Accepted Alicante objects are retained complete-object exact even when current source labels differ.
StopNode.sourceReferences is empty because no genuine OpenStreetMap platform or stop_position evidence was used.
